expected_response.note: No registered bounded edit is expected to improve the primary affinity objective given the supplied evidence; incumbent retained.

failure_modes: A pair-kernel or joint-RMS contrast is treated as if the executing pointcloud scalar contained that term; it does not (formula_registry diagnostic_limit).
Occupancy signs are pooled across landmarks into one quality axis even though occupancy is a radial shell density peaking at a and is not monotone in distance.
A temporal derivative or observed-node trend is read as a spatial gradient or as a validated temporal salience signal despite polynomial_accepted false and high relative node RMSE.
Recorded joint-head survival credit is presented as decoded terminal affinity benefit although decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable.
A temperature edit is proposed; temperatures are immutable fixed parameters.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible signed contrasts are on short-range pair-distance shell densities (endpoint_effects:9-11 positive with positive batch fraction 1.0; endpoint_effects:13 negative with positive batch fraction 0.0; branch_adjusted:163,164,240,241), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions pair_kernel is a radial shell density, not a bond label or interaction energy). No registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) changes that observable, so no operative edit is connected to the Analyst's top hypothesis. The joint-motion diagnostics are the most reproducible coordinate effects (branch_adjusted:74-76,151-153,228-230,305-307) but are likewise not terms of the executing reward. Landmark occupancy/softmin contrasts are mixed in sign and occupancy is not monotone in distance, so they cannot be pooled into a single favorable direction for a region_index edit. Continuous observed-node trends have polynomial_accepted false, high relative node RMSE and frequent sign conflicts (continuous:0-9; curve_support), so a temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit is not supported by a stable temporal signal. Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; clocks label_semantics), so last-record joint-head credit cannot be treated as final affinity benefit and the affinity-first objective cannot be shown to improve. Temperatures are immutable fixed parameters (fixed_parameters mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0) and are not proposed. Because no registered edit has a defensible expected advantage on the primary affinity objective, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a reproducible signed contrast on an observable the executing pointcloud scalar actually contains, or a stable temporal salience signal.
